game.title: Nioh 3
game.blurb: Soulslike samurai action RPG from Team Ninja, released 2026-02-06. RAWG has no playtime yet. Genre: Action. Chapters are an estimate drawn from Steam achievement themes.

chapters.title: The Main Story
chapters.summary: The main missions across eras, to the final battle.

chapters.title: Exploration and Regions
chapters.summary: Shrines, enemy bases, Crucibles, Kodama, Jizo, hot springs and Spirit Veins.

chapters.title: Masters and Myths
chapters.summary: Defeat every master and complete every Myth.

chapters.title: Combat, Martial Arts and Gear
chapters.summary: Martial arts, ninjutsu, Burst Breaks, forging and set bonuses.

chapters.title: Hell Rising and Endgame
chapters.summary: The harder Hell Rising mode, picture scrolls and late-game challenges.
